# Wringer

> Bounded engineering loops, independent review, portable evidence and measured improvement.

- [Start](README.md): choose verification or delegation and read current limits.
- [Install](INSTALL.md): native archive, candidate channels and contributor setup.
- [Agent contract](USING_WRINGER.md): modes, structured observations and authority.
- [Agent setup](docs/START_AGENT.md): name your MCP client, propose, relay the decision link.
- [Trusted-local](docs/native/TRUSTED_LOCAL.md): delegate to your own Claude Code or Codex on this computer; nothing contained.
- [Clients](docs/ASSISTANT_COMPATIBILITY.md): connection recipes for eight named MCP clients and what was measured.
- [PM review](docs/START_PM.md): approve, inspect, correct/accept and separate Send.
- [Operator](docs/START_OPERATOR.md): provisioning, owners and local state.
- [CLI](docs/CLI.md): generated executable help and exit codes.
- [Loop inspection](docs/native/LOOP_INSPECTION.md): candidate decisions, repair evidence and remaining reservations.
- [Portable bundles](examples/evidence/README.md): independent reader and semantic audit.
- [Measured improvement](docs/native/EXPERIMENTS.md): predictions, comparisons and future-only adoption.
- [Overview](docs/OVERVIEW.md): what Wringer does, with commands.
- [Capabilities](docs/CAPABILITIES.md): implemented, qualified and planned features.
- [Restoration](docs/SOTA_RESTORATION_PLAN.md): graphs, competition, durability and interoperability.
- [Recovery](docs/MIGRATION.md): uncertainty, migration, rollback and uninstall.
- [Evidence](EVIDENCE.md): measured, unavailable, failed and unmeasured claims.
- [Security](SECURITY.md): trust boundaries and private reporting.

This index is optional documentation. No client is assumed to discover it.
